title: Millimetre and sub-millimetre spectroscopy of doubly deuterated acetaldehyde (CHD<SUB>2</SUB>CHO) and first detection towards IRAS 16293-2422
question: Can doubly deuterated acetaldehyde (CHD2CHO) be detected in the interstellar medium towards IRAS 16293-2422 using a new laboratory spectroscopic catalogue, and what are its column density and D2/D ratio?

what.value: Previously measured microwave transitions of CHD2CHO

evidence.quote: In this section, the experimental spectrum is described and, after briefly outlining the IAM approach, the fitting of previously available microwave transitions (cite: turner:76; turner:81) and of the newly measured submillimetre ones is reported.

what.value: Energy difference E_d' for the monodeuterated species CH2DCHO (15.55866(4) cm^-1)

evidence.quote: Since $E_{d}'$, first estimated by (cite: turner:81) and (cite: cox:03) and determined later with a higher accuracy by (cite: coudert:19), is $15.558\,66(4)$ cm$^{-1}$, we obtain $E_d= 14.487$ cm$^{-1}$.

what.value: Molecular structure and dipole moment components for acetaldehyde

evidence.quote: Table 1 of the present paper lists computed values for the rotational constants and dipole moment components of the In and Out configurations as retrieved from the structure of (cite: kilb:57) and the dipole moment components reported in Table 16 of (cite: turner:78) for .

what.value: Column density of singly deuterated acetaldehyde CH2DCHO (6.2 x 10^15 cm^-2) and D/H ratio towards IRAS 16293-2422

evidence.quote: The derived column density can be compared to that of the singly deuterated variant, CH$_2$DCHO, of $6.2\times10^{15}$ cm$^{-2}$ (cite: manigand:20).

The acetaldehyde D$_{2}$/D ratio found in this work and the D/H ratio from (cite: manigand:20) combined with a gas-grain chemical model can potentially shed light on the formation mechanism of singly- and multi-deuterated acetaldehyde.

what.value: Doubly-to-singly deuterated ratios towards IRAS 16293-2422 for methyl formate (22%), dimethylether (15-20%), and methanol (25%)

evidence.quote: The ratio between the singly and doubly deuterated variants of 20% is very close to those for methyl formate (CHD$_2$OCHO/CH$_2$DOCHO) of 22% (cite: manigand:19), dimethylether (CH$_3$OCHD$_2$/CH$_2$OCH$_2$D) of 15-20% (cite: richard:21) and methanol (CHD$_{2}$OH/CH$_{2}$DOH) of 25% (cite: drozdovskaya:22)

what.value: Average column density of CH3CHO towards starless cores (2 x 10^12 cm^-2) and [CH3CHO]/[CH3OH] ratios (0.02 to 0.26)

evidence.quote: Acetaldehyde is less abundant than methanol in pre-stellar cores with a \[CH$_{3}$CHO\]/\[CH$_{3}$OH\] ratios betweewn 0.02 and 0.26 (cite: scibelli:20).

We base our estimate on the average column density of observed towards starless cores in (cite: scibelli:20) (2$\times10^{12}$ cm$^{-2}$), and assuming the D/H and D$_{2}$/H ratio observed towards IRAS16293.

recipe.goal: Measure laboratory rotational spectrum and build spectroscopic catalogue for CHD2CHO
recipe.method: Record rotational transitions between 82.5 and 450 GHz in the laboratory, combine with archival microwave transitions, fit with an effective IAM/Watson A-set Hamiltonian using weighted least-squares, and compute a JPL-format line catalogue up to J=28
key_parameters: Frequency range = 82.5–450 GHz, 853 transitions fitted, 40 spectroscopic constants varied
Catalogue up to J = 28, LOGSTR0 = -8, LOGSTR1 = -8, minimum calculated error = 10 kHz
assumptions: E_d = 14.487 cm^-1 computed from ab initio B3LYP/6-31G(d) ratio r = E_d/E_d' = 0.9311 and CH2DCHO E_d' = 15.55866(4) cm^-1
Zero energy set at Out configurations 0_00,+ level; rotational partition function degeneracy factor = (2J+1)

recipe.goal: Search for CHD2CHO and fit LTE synthetic spectra to ALMA PILS data
recipe.method: Extract spectrum at position offset by one beam (0.5'') from IRAS 16293-2422 B and fit LTE synthetic spectra across the Band 7 frequency range (329.1–362.9 GHz)
key_parameters: Line width (FWHM) = 1 km s^-1, velocity offset (v_LSR) = 2.6 km s^-1, T_rot = 125 K
68 transitions predicted to be brighter than 40 mJy beam^-1 km s^-1 inspected over 329.1–362.9 GHz
assumptions: Rotational temperature fixed at T_rot = 125 K, matching non-deuterated and singly-deuterated isotopologues of acetaldehyde

recipe.goal: Compute D2/D ratio for acetaldehyde and estimate 3 mm line brightness towards pre-stellar cores
recipe.method: Compare derived CHD2CHO column density with literature CH2DCHO column density towards IRAS 16293-2422 B, and estimate 3 mm band line brightnesses in pre-stellar cores from average starless core CH3CHO column density
assumptions: Assume average starless core CH3CHO column density of 2 x 10^12 cm^-2 from Scibelli & Shirley (2020) and D/H and D2/H ratios equal to those observed towards IRAS 16293-2422

Column density of CHD2CHO towards IRAS 16293-2422 B

evidence.quote: The first detection of the species allows for the derivation of its column density with a value of 1.3$\times$10$^{15}$ cm$^{-2}$ and an uncertainty of 10-20%.
Several clean and unblended transitions are seen providing a good constraint on the CHD$_2$CHO column density of 1.3$\times 10^{15}$ cm$^{-2}$ with an uncertainty of 10-20%

answer_key.quantity: CHD2CHO / CH2DCHO (D2/D) column density ratio towards IRAS 16293-2422 B

evidence.quote: The resulting D$_{2}$/D ratio of $\sim$ 20% is found to be coincident with D$_{2}$/D ratios derived for other complex organic molecules towards IRAS 16293-2422
The ratio between the singly and doubly deuterated variants of 20% is very close to those for methyl formate (CHD$_2$OCHO/CH$_2$DOCHO) of 22% (cite: manigand:19)

evidence.quote: We estimate the line brightness of the most intense lines of the singly and doubly deuterated acetaldehyde in the 3 mm band towards pre-stellar cores to be 4.3 mK and 0.5 mK, respectively.

score_reason: The new spectroscopic catalogue is published at CDS/CDMS, the ALMA PILS data are public, and the fixed LTE parameters (T_rot = 125 K, FWHM = 1 km s^-1, v_LSR = 2.6 km s^-1) and 68 transitions are explicitly listed. However, exact extraction coordinates, source size/continuum treatment in LTE, and the specific radiative transfer fitting software are deferred to earlier PILS papers.
rediscovery_reason: The ALMA PILS dataset (2013.1.00278.S) and the CDMS/CDS spectroscopic catalogue for CHD2CHO are publicly available, and the main astrophysical result is a numeric column density (1.3e15 cm^-2) and D2/D ratio (20%) derived with clearly stated LTE parameters.
